import os
import pathlib
import stat
import pytest
import click
from click._compat import WIN
def test_open_file_pathlib_dash(runner):

    @click.command()
    @click.argument('filename', type=click.Path(allow_dash=True, path_type=pathlib.Path))
    def cli(filename):
        click.echo(str(type(filename)))
        with click.open_file(filename) as f:
            click.echo(f.read())
        result = runner.invoke(cli, ['-'], input='value')
        assert result.exception is None
        assert result.output == 'pathlib.Path\nvalue\n'
